text:
Anya: FYI BART between 12th & Embarcadero is single-tracking due to a 'tunnel alarm' — trains are crawling. Thinking of pushing my arrival to ~10:30. Anyone else getting hit?
Jamal: I'm on the 9:58 from MacArthur, PA announcement said 10-15m delays. debating switching to Muni.
Maria C: Missed my transfer at 19th. Gonna scooter the last mile :scooter: Anyone need a lift 19th -> Montgomery?
Ryan: I've got room for 2, leaving Mission/16th in ~12 mins. DM me if you want a spot.
Olivia: Office status check — pretty empty atm, kitchen table & a couple desks free if you want to work from there.
CommuterBot: BART ALERT: Single tracking between 12th St/Oakland and Embarcadero. Expect delays of 10-25 minutes. https://status.bart.example/alerts
Anya: Thanks @Ryan! @Maria C any chance I can tag along on the scooter?
Maria C: sure — meet by the bike rack outside 19th in 7.
Jamal: hopped on N Judah instead. surprisingly less packed, saved ~8 mins.
Olivia: Quick poll — react with :train: = staying on BART, :scooter: = scooter, :car: = taking a ride, :walking: = walking
Ryan: :car: (count me)
Maria C: :scooter: 
Jamal: :walking: 
Anya: :scooter:
Olivia: Nice — mini modal shift. Stay safe y'all, coffee on me if you make it in :coffee:
